geometry.note: 'other', not 'hall', because this is a single undifferentiated position for the whole underground complex, not this hall's own surveyed footprint (which is not sourced this session, feature_type='hall' would imply a footprint polygon this record does not have).

method: Midpoint (6142 m from the Assergi portal) of geometry:lngs-lab-access-zone, itself walked along the OSM tunnel line from the official emergency-plan chainage of the laboratory's entrance and exit doors (see that record's method). This is the best-sourced position for the LNGS underground complex as a whole; no fetched source this session distinguishes which position within the roughly 700 m access zone this hall occupies, or the order of Halls A, B and C along it, so all three hall records are drawn at this same point and accuracy_m is widened to 400 m (roughly the zone's own half-span) to say so honestly.
name: LNGS Hall B (undifferentiated position within the underground complex)
notes: Duplicate coordinates with geometry:lngs-hall-a and geometry:lngs-hall-c are intentional: the three halls are known to lie within the same sourced ~700 m zone, but nothing fetched this session orders them along it. See the facility worklog.

site:lngs-hall-b is facility:lngs's primary_site_id and currently carries the same 8 km-precision Assergi address coordinate as the other two halls; this derived point (400 m accuracy) is offered as a site coordinate correction in the worklog.

summary.plain: An approximate marker for LNGS Hall B, placed at the centre of the sourced ~700-metre zone that the three main halls occupy; their individual order along it is not sourced.
